```{r}
#===================================================================
# Export nerve annotation CSV + labeled overview images
#===================================================================
# Rather than fully automating pixel-perfect crops (blocked by
# coordinate-system mismatches across available image sources -- see
# chat history), this script:
#   1) Writes one CSV row per nerve with its ID, sample, invasion
#      status, spot count, and centroid coordinates (in BOTH this
#      object's native pxl_*_in_fullres units AND the embedded hires
#      image's pixel units, since the latter is what you'll visually
#      match against when cropping from a bigger image).
#   2) Saves one full-tissue overview PNG per sample, with each
#      nerve's ID printed directly at its location on the H&E +
#      Area-colored spots -- so you can visually locate it on
#      whichever higher-resolution image you trust and crop manually.
#   3) Saves horizontally-mirrored versions of every overview (with
#      and without NerveID labels), for visually matching against a
#      raw TIFF that may be stored in a flipped orientation.
#
# WHAT THIS PRODUCES
# --------------------
# Tables (output/09_pathologist_annotation_export/tables/):
#   - nerve_annotations.csv
#       One row per nerve: ID, sample, patient, invasion status, spot
#       count, and centroid/bounding-box coordinates in both native
#       full-res pixel units and the embedded hires image's units.
# Figures (output/09_pathologist_annotation_export/figures/):
#   - nerve_overview_<sample_id>.png
#       One per sample: H&E + Area-colored spots, NerveID labeled at
#       each nerve's location.
#   figures/flipped/:
#   - nerve_overview_<sample_id>_mirrored.png
#       Same, horizontally mirrored, WITH NerveID labels.
#   - nerve_overview_<sample_id>_mirrored_nolabels.png
#       Same, horizontally mirrored, WITHOUT labels (cleaner for visual
#       matching against a raw TIFF).
#
# BUGFIX (this pass): the original script reassigned `out_fig_dir`
# partway through (from "pathologist/figures" to
# "pathologist/figures/flipped") but never created that second
# directory -- ggsave() into it would have failed with "cannot open
# file". Now uses two distinct, both-created variables
# (FIGURES_DIR / FIGURES_DIR_FLIPPED) instead of reusing one name for
# two different folders.
#===================================================================

library(SpatialExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(ggspavis)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ---- 0. Directory structure -------------------------------------------
# Paths are relative to the project folder (the one containing input/).
# Run from there, or from scripts/ -- this moves up one level if needed.
if (basename(getwd()) == "scripts") setwd("..")
if (!dir.exists("input"))
  stop("Run this script from the project folder (the one containing input/).")

PROJECT_DIR   <- "."
INPUT_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "input")

ANALYSIS_NAME <- "07_pathologist_annotation_export"
TABLES_DIR    <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "tables")
FIGURES_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "figures")
FIGURES_DIR_FLIPPED <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "flipped")
dir.create(TABLES_DIR,          recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR,         recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR_FLIPPED, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

out_csv <- file.path(TABLES_DIR, "nerve_annotations.csv")
```

```{r}
#   Masked by S4Vectors/IRanges/BiocGenerics (Bioconductor):
first     <- dplyr::first
rename    <- dplyr::rename
union     <- dplyr::union
intersect <- dplyr::intersect
setdiff   <- dplyr::setdiff
#   Masked by base R packages (stats) -- classic, unrelated to
#   Bioconductor, but worth pinning defensively in the same place:
filter    <- dplyr::filter
lag       <- dplyr::lag
#   Not currently conflicting here, but pinned as standard practice
#   across this project's scripts (see e.g. gene_containment_setup_
#   cleaned.R), since plyr masks these with incompatible signatures if
#   it's ever loaded later in the same session:
count     <- dplyr::count
summarise <- dplyr::summarise
summarize <- dplyr::summarize
mutate    <- dplyr::mutate
arrange   <- dplyr::arrange
select    <- dplyr::select
slice     <- dplyr::slice
pull      <- dplyr::pull
distinct  <- dplyr::distinct
group_by  <- dplyr::group_by
```



```{r}
# Load integrated spatial object
spe <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "Integrated_NMF.rds"))

# Load accompanying metadata
colData(spe) <- DataFrame(read.csv(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "DE_SPE_annotaion.csv")))

# Ensure column names match barcodes
colnames(spe) <- spe$barcode
```

```{r}
#-------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Build per-nerve summary table (centroid + metadata)
#-------------------------------------------------------------------

sc <- as.data.frame(spatialCoords(spe))
meta_cols <- as.data.frame(colData(spe))[, c("sample_id", "NerveID", "Invaded",
                                              "patient_id", "context")]
nerve_df <- cbind(sc, meta_cols) %>% filter(!is.na(NerveID))

sf_table <- as.data.frame(imgData(spe))[, c("sample_id", "scaleFactor")]

nerve_summary <- nerve_df %>%
  group_by(sample_id, NerveID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_spots       = n(),
    invaded_vals  = paste(sort(unique(Invaded)), collapse = "|"),
    patient_id    = first(patient_id),
    context       = first(context),
    col_centroid_full = mean(pxl_col_in_fullres, na.rm = TRUE),
    row_centroid_full = mean(pxl_row_in_fullres, na.rm = TRUE),
    col_min_full  = min(pxl_col_in_fullres, na.rm = TRUE),
    col_max_full  = max(pxl_col_in_fullres, na.rm = TRUE),
    row_min_full  = min(pxl_row_in_fullres, na.rm = TRUE),
    row_max_full  = max(pxl_row_in_fullres, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(sf_table, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(
    Invaded_label = case_when(
      invaded_vals == "Invaded"    ~ "Invaded",
      invaded_vals == "NonInvaded" ~ "NonInvaded",
      TRUE ~ paste0("AMBIGUOUS:", invaded_vals)
    ),
    # centroid + bbox in the embedded hires-image's own pixel units --
    # useful for visually matching this location on a bigger image
    col_centroid_img = col_centroid_full * scaleFactor,
    row_centroid_img = row_centroid_full * scaleFactor,
    col_min_img = col_min_full * scaleFactor,
    col_max_img = col_max_full * scaleFactor,
    row_min_img = row_min_full * scaleFactor,
    row_max_img = row_max_full * scaleFactor
  ) %>%
  select(-invaded_vals) %>%
  mutate(
    UniqueNerveID = paste0(sample_id, "_Nerve", NerveID)   
  ) %>%
  relocate(UniqueNerveID, .before = sample_id)

if (any(grepl("AMBIGUOUS", nerve_summary$Invaded_label))) {
  warning("Some NerveIDs mix Invaded and NonInvaded spots — check before trusting labels:\n",
          paste(nerve_summary$NerveID[grepl("AMBIGUOUS", nerve_summary$Invaded_label)], collapse = ", "))
}

write.csv(nerve_summary, out_csv, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
message("Wrote ", nrow(nerve_summary), " nerve records to ", out_csv)

#-------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Labeled overview plot per sample (H&E + Area + NerveID labels)
#-------------------------------------------------------------------

for (s in unique(spe$sample_id)) {

  spe_s <- spe[, spe$sample_id == s & spe$Area != "other"]
  if (ncol(spe_s) == 0) next   # sample has no annotated Area spots

  p <- plotVisium(
    spe_s,
    x_coord = "pxl_col_in_fullres",
    y_coord = "pxl_row_in_fullres",
    spots = TRUE,
    image = TRUE,
    fill = "Area",
    y_reverse = TRUE
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "InvadedNerve"  = "#1f77b4",
        "Nerve"         = "#2ca02c",
        "TumorDistal"   = "#ff7f0e",
        "TumorProximal" = "#d62728"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "InvadedNerve"  = "Invaded Nerve",
        "Nerve"         = "Non-invaded Nerve",
        "TumorDistal"   = "Tumor Distal",
        "TumorProximal" = "Tumor Proximal"
      )
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal") +
    ggtitle(s)

  if (ncol(spe_s) > 0) {
    built <- ggplot_build(p)
    pt_layer_idx <- which(sapply(p$layers, function(l) inherits(l$geom, "GeomPoint")))[1]
    pt_data <- built$data[[pt_layer_idx]]

    meta_s <- as.data.frame(colData(spe_s))
    stopifnot(nrow(pt_data) == nrow(meta_s))   # must match row-for-row to trust this join
    pt_data$NerveID <- meta_s$NerveID

    label_df <- pt_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(NerveID)) %>%
      group_by(NerveID) %>%
      summarise(x = mean(x), y = mean(y), .groups = "drop")

    if (nrow(label_df) > 0) {
      p <- p + geom_label(
        data = label_df,
        aes(x = x, y = y, label = NerveID),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 5, fontface = "bold",
        color = "black", fill = "white",
        label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"),
        label.r = unit(0.1, "lines"),
        alpha = 0.9
      )
    }
  }

  out_path <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR, paste0("nerve_overview_", s, ".png"))
  ggsave(out_path, p, width = 16, height = 16, dpi = 300)
  message("Saved ", out_path)
}
```

```{r}
#-------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: build an overview plot for one sample, with optional
# horizontal/vertical flip of the tissue image (points + labels are
# recomputed to match, and stay upright).
#-------------------------------------------------------------------

plot_sample_flipped <- function(sample_id_val, flip_horizontal = FALSE, flip_vertical = FALSE,
                                 show_labels = TRUE) {
  img <- imgRaster(spe, sample_id = sample_id_val, image_id = "hires")
  n_row <- dim(img)[1]; n_col <- dim(img)[2]
  img_disp <- img
  if (flip_horizontal) img_disp <- img_disp[, n_col:1]
  if (flip_vertical)   img_disp <- img_disp[n_row:1, ]
  sf <- imgData(spe)$scaleFactor[imgData(spe)$sample_id == sample_id_val]
  spe_s <- spe[, spe$sample_id == sample_id_val & spe$Area != "other"]
  sc_s <- as.data.frame(spatialCoords(spe_s))
  meta_s <- as.data.frame(colData(spe_s))
  spots_df <- data.frame(
    col_img = sc_s$pxl_col_in_fullres * sf,
    row_img = sc_s$pxl_row_in_fullres * sf,
    Area = meta_s$Area,
    NerveID = meta_s$NerveID
  )
  spots_df <- spots_df %>%
    mutate(
      x_plot = if (flip_horizontal) (n_col - col_img) else col_img,
      y_plot = if (flip_vertical)   row_img            else (n_row - row_img)
    )
  label_df <- spots_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(NerveID)) %>%
    group_by(NerveID) %>%
    summarise(x_plot = mean(x_plot), y_plot = mean(y_plot), .groups = "drop")
  p <- ggplot() +
    annotation_raster(img_disp, xmin = 0, xmax = n_col, ymin = 0, ymax = n_row) +
    geom_point(data = spots_df, aes(x = x_plot, y = y_plot, color = Area), size = 1.2) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "InvadedNerve"  = "#1f77b4",
        "Nerve"         = "#2ca02c",
        "TumorDistal"   = "#ff7f0e",
        "TumorProximal" = "#d62728"
      )
    ) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, n_col), ylim = c(0, n_row), expand = FALSE) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    ggtitle(paste0(sample_id_val,
                   if (flip_horizontal) " [flipped horizontally]" else "",
                   if (flip_vertical)   " [flipped vertically]"   else ""))
  if (show_labels && nrow(label_df) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_label(
      data = label_df,
      aes(x = x_plot, y = y_plot, label = NerveID),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 5, fontface = "bold",
      color = "black", fill = "white",
      label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"),
      alpha = 0.9
    )
  }
  p
}
```

```{r}
#-------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate the mirrored overview for EVERY sample (WITH labels), so
# you can visually match each one against its corresponding raw TIFF
# and confirm whether this orientation actually lines up.
#-------------------------------------------------------------------

for (s in unique(spe$sample_id)) {

  spe_check <- spe[, spe$sample_id == s & spe$Area != "other"]
  if (ncol(spe_check) == 0) next   # sample has no annotated Area spots

  p <- plot_sample_flipped(s, flip_horizontal = TRUE, flip_vertical = FALSE)

  out_path <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR_FLIPPED, sprintf("nerve_overview_%s_mirrored.png", s))
  ggsave(out_path, p, width = 14, height = 14, dpi = 250)
  message("Saved ", out_path)
}
```

```{r}
#-------------------------------------------------------------------
# Same mirrored overviews, WITHOUT labels -- cleaner for visual
# matching against a raw TIFF where the printed NerveID text would
# just be visual clutter.
#-------------------------------------------------------------------
for (s in unique(spe$sample_id)) {
  spe_check <- spe[, spe$sample_id == s & spe$Area != "other"]
  if (ncol(spe_check) == 0) next

  p_nolabel <- plot_sample_flipped(s, flip_horizontal = TRUE, flip_vertical = FALSE, show_labels = FALSE)
  out_path <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR_FLIPPED, sprintf("nerve_overview_%s_mirrored_nolabels.png", s))
  ggsave(out_path, p_nolabel, width = 14, height = 14, dpi = 250)
  message("Saved ", out_path)
}
```
